note: Playable scenarios. Each names its map centre in thousandths of a degree; its regions, firms and starting balance come from the rest of content/.

scenarios.name: Great Lakes, 2000
scenarios.summary: Thirty-one regions across eight states around the Great Lakes and the Ohio Valley. Farms, steel, autos and freight at the turn of the century, with rivals already in every market.
scenarios.region: Great Lakes and Ohio Valley, United States
scenarios.tagline: Steel, autos and farms at the turn of the century, on stretched credit.

scenarios.name: Texas Oil Patch, 1981
scenarios.summary: Oil at forty dollars a barrel, banks lending against every rig, and the 1982 bust a year away. Drill, refine and survive the savings-and-loan crash.
scenarios.region: Texas, Oklahoma and Louisiana, United States
scenarios.tagline: Boom, bust and the savings-and-loan crisis.

scenarios.name: Silicon Valley, 1995
scenarios.summary: The web arrives. Chips, software and telecoms race for capital as valuations climb toward the dot-com peak and the crash after it.
scenarios.tagline: Ride the dot-com boom and live through the crash.

scenarios.name: Ruhr and Rhine, 1991
scenarios.summary: Germany has just reunified. Rebuild the east's industry, compete with western giants, and answer to a hawkish Bundesbank guarding the Deutsche Mark.
scenarios.tagline: Reunification, the D-Mark and a hawkish central bank.
